name: Solve sequence puzzles and pattern recognition tasks
description: Users asked to solve sequence puzzles by identifying the next term, missing elements, or underlying patterns in lists of numbers, letters, or positions within a grid. These requests also included performing working memory tests, such as 1-back and 2-back tasks, and applying specific formatting constraints to the outputs.
